name: agingRoofs
description: Find properties inside a radius whose estimated roof age is at least minAgeYears, oldest first. Returns the total match count plus rows (address, roof_age_years, roof_age_confidence, roof_age_basis, owner, miles from pin, property_key). Set withoutOpenPermit=true to keep only properties that have no open permit.

minAgeYears.description: Minimum estimated roof age in years (default suggestion: 15).

withoutOpenPermit.description: Only return properties with no open permit of any kind. Default false.

name: openPermits
description: Find open permits inside a radius, longest-open first (years_open). filter 'roofing' = open permits classified as roofing; 'roofing_low' = also include low/medium-confidence roofing matches; 'all_open' = every open permit. Rows include permit_no, status, years_open, open_since, contractor_name, bbb_score, address, miles, property_key.

name: permitCounts
description: Count open permits in a radius grouped by roofing confidence (none/low/medium/high). Useful to explain why a roofing search is empty.

name: permitsForProperty
description: All permits (any status) on one property, newest first. Takes a property_key returned by another tool.

propertyKey.description: A property_key from a previous result.

name: propertyByKey
description: One property's full record (owner, roof age with basis/confidence/caveat, market value, BBB score). Takes a property_key returned by another tool.

propertyKey.description: A property_key from a previous result.
